results.text: A Double-blind, Randomized, Multicenter Clinical Trial Investigating the Efficacy and Safety of Esomeprazole Single Therapy Versus Mosapride and Esomeprazole Combined Therapy in Patients with Esophageal Reflux Disease. We aim to evaluate the efficacy and safety of combination therapy in erosive reflux disease (ERD) patients by comparing endoscopic healing rates according to the Los Angeles classification for esomeprazole alone, and esomeprazole plus mosapride.

results.text: Comparative Efficacy of Potassium-Competitive Acid Blockers (P-CABs) Versus Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPIs) in the Management of Erosive Esophagitis: A Systematic Review. This systematic review evaluates the efficacy and safety of vonoprazan and compares it with proton pump inhibitors (PPIs) for the healing and maintenance of erosive esophagitis (EE).
